items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: A clean, token-based Base UI accordion with four style families (flush, bordered, card, timeline), chevron / plus-minus / numbered / icon indicators, nested layouts and expand-all control.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: A fully rounded, matte button with clean token-driven variants (solid, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, link, frame), a built-in loading state, and six sizes.

items.name: button-kit
items.title: Button Kit
items.description: 45 ready-made button patterns on top of the Button — actions (add to cart, save, delete with confirm, refresh), states (loading, success, error shake, progress, countdown, hold to confirm), toggles (like, bookmark, follow, theme, mute), auth/social buttons, icon-only buttons and layout buttons (group, split, segmented control, pagination).

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A badge with cultural icon, status dot, loading, and size variants drawn inline with theme tokens.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A soft tonal card — large radius, borderless, layered shadows — with size presets, a --card-spacing spacing variable, a sand-gradient media zone, an opt-in faint Odisha watermark (deula, chakra, or padma), and an Ikat ornament strip.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A separator with heritage ornament, tiled-pattern, and motif variants drawn inline with theme tokens.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A loading skeleton with shimmer, ikat, and pida variants, heritage shapes, and faint temple artwork for media placeholders.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A loading spinner with cultural glyphs — turning Konark chakra, breathing deula, opening lotus — plus dots, ring, and pulse styles.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A form label with required asterisk, optional pill, invalid, and disabled states, plus a FieldMessage for helper and error text.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text input with warm rounded fields, search, email, password, and file presets, start/end icons, addons, sizes, and built-in error messages.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field with resize control, a live character counter, and built-in error messages.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A clean, token-based alert with six semantic colours (default, info, success, important, warning, destructive), soft / outline / solid looks, inline actions and GitHub-style docs callouts.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A Base UI avatar with optional Odisha heritage frames — chakra, padma, deula, ikat, pattachitra — accent colours, heritage fallbacks, and status badges.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A Base UI toggle switch with a cultural chakra motif in the thumb when checked, sm and default sizes, and theme-token track colours.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: A Base UI set of pill-shaped toggle buttons sharing pressed state, single or multiple selection, with borderless tonal default, ghost, outline, and secondary variants and five sizes.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: A Base UI radio group with a dashed ikat-style unchecked ring, a cultural chakra indicator when checked, and full keyboard navigation.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A Base UI dialog with a borderless rounded-3xl surface and large soft shadow, size presets, faint deula and chakra watermarks, an Ikat-patterned banner header, media slots, and an Ikat ornament strip.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A Base UI sheet with a faint rekha deula watermark on by default (opt-out-able), plus a chakra watermark, an Ikat ornament strip, a grabber handle, header icon slots, and rounded top and bottom edges.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A Base UI slider whose thumbs carry cultural motifs from the Badge icon set — a mini Konark wheel by default — with optional Ikat-diamond tick markers along the track.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: A Base UI toast system with a borderless soft-shadow surface, a faint deula watermark on every toast by default (chakra or none as options) and cultural type icons — success bana, info padma, warning ikat, error jagannath.

items.description: Pay with UPI checkout button.

items.name: submit-button
items.title: Submit Button
items.description: Submit button with loading and valid state.

items.name: google-sign-in-button
items.title: Google Sign In Button
items.description: Continue with Google button.

items.name: send-otp-button
items.title: Send OTP Button
items.description: Send OTP button with resend countdown.

items.name: whatsapp-share-button
items.title: WhatsApp Share Button
items.description: Share to WhatsApp button.

items.name: wishlist-button
items.title: Wishlist Button
items.description: Wishlist heart toggle button.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy Button
items.description: Copy to clipboard button with copied state.

items.name: download-button
items.title: Download Button
items.description: Download button with progress feedback.

items.name: delete-confirm-button
items.title: Delete Confirm Button
items.description: Destructive confirm button for delete/cancel order.

items.name: language-toggle-button
items.title: Language Toggle Button
items.description: Toggle between Odia and English.
